topic: DP-3T: A Privacy-Preserving Approach to Contact Tracing
target_audience: University Students (Computer Science, Public Health, or related fields)

sections.title: The Challenge: Contact Tracing and Privacy
lecture_lines: Contact tracing is crucial for controlling outbreaks.
Digital solutions can also compromise data.
A new approach is needed for privacy.

animations: FadeIn the text 'DP-3T uses Bluetooth for proximity.'

sections.title: The Technology: Bluetooth & Cryptographic Keys
lecture_lines: When diagnosed, you report to the server.
